reason: All opcodes are NMOS/65SC12-legal (DEY, BMI rel, LDX abs,Y, BEQ, LDA zp,X, BPL, STY zp); no BBR/RMB etc. Recount: a skipped entry was DEY 2 + STY zp 3 + LDX abs,Y 4 (act at &BC6E-&BC8F, no page cross) + BEQ 2 + JSR 6 + take_off's LDA need,X 4 + BPL taken 3 + RTS 6 + LDY ren_k 3 + BNE taken 3 = 36; new DEY 2 + BMI 2 + LDX 4 + BEQ 2 + LDA need,X 4 + BPL taken 3 = 17: 19 saved, as claimed. Not in the per-execution claim: a stale entry (bit 7 set) now costs 8 more (BMI 2, LDA 4, BPL untaken 2; take_off still repeats its own test), and a non-player index 0 skipped ends via BPL/DEY/BMI taken for 13 saved instead of 19; with the window's counts (about 7.25 iterations, 5.05 skipped, about 1.2 stale, about 1 player exit a pass) that nets roughly 5.05*19 - 1.2*8 = 86, less the shift's crossings, near the 77 claimed. Bytes: old 12, new 18, so the code grows by 6 (claim bytes -6 = saved -6). Bank 4 ends at &B37D, under REN_BASE &B400 (131 free). The new loop, &92DD to &92F1 with taken_off at &92F2, keeps every branch inside page &92 (BEQ taken_off offset &15, BPL/BNE taking_off backwards in the page). I scanned the listing for branches after &92EC that start or stop crossing a page with +6: BNE going_on &97F5, BRA gather &97FA, BEQ no_part &9DD0 and BEQ out &A2F7 start crossing; BEQ in_hazel &9CFC, BEQ gathered &9EFD and BNE gather &9F39 stop crossing. That matches the candidate's list apart from BEQ out, which is cold. Indexed tables that move are for the gate to measure. Semantics: take_off on a need bit 7 clear slot is LDA/BPL/RTS with no side effect, and the pre-test reads need,X just where take_off would. BMI is reached only after index 0 was skipped (Y 0 -> &FF), because act_n <= MOVER_SLOTS (34), so Y never reaches 128 otherwise. At taken_off Y can now be &FF, not 0, but Y is dead: the scroll path does LDY #0 first; buffer_to_view, view_to_buffer and ren_plot_lives set or ignore Y; section 6 does LDY #0. X at exit is act[0] as before. ren_k may be left non-zero, but every later reader (apply_entries, mark_to_draw, close_over_overlaps' gather) writes it before reading, and only render.6502 uses it. No self-modified operand or code read as data lies in the lines replaced. Labels move with the code.
